messages:
Marie L.: PSA — my new UV grow lamp just arrived. Plants are thriving but my home Wi‑Fi keeps dropping every 10–15 mins when the lamp is on. Anyone seen lights mess with routers?
Devin: which lamp? brand/model?
Marie L.: AukerSun 40W, has a metal clamp and a timer. Plugged into same power strip as the router temporarily while I set it up :grimacing:
A.J.: metal + RF + cheap power supply = drama. Try moving router off that strip first.
Samir: can you paste a quick `speedtest-cli --simple` run when it drops? curious if it's packet loss or total disconnect.
Marie L.: ok here's a snippet when it dropped: ```Ping: 250 ms
Download: 2.3 Mbps
Upload: 0.5 Mbps
Packet loss: ~40%```
Katie: yikes. that looks like interference. did you try 5GHz? some lights only mess with 2.4.
Alex: also check for smart plug/driver chatter. some LED drivers radios are noisy.
Marie L.: good call — router is 2.4 primary. will switch to 5G and retest.
infra-bot: Note: residential isp outages reported in your area? None in the last 24h. (check-infra)
Devin: if you still see issues, try `iwlist wlan0 scan` (linux) to see overlapping channels or use the Wifi Analyzer app on phone.
A.J.: pro tip: unplug lamp, wait 30s, plug in lamp but keep router powered — if problem returns it's the lamp.
Marie L.: update — unplugged lamp and wifi immediately stable. Plugged lamp into different outlet 6ft away and now it's fine. Strange but solved :relieved:
Samir: great detective work. if it recurs, swap in a USB wifi dongle or a powerline adapter as a workaround.
Katie: post a plant photo for the threadery!
Marie L.: https://img.example.com/philodendron-sprout.jpg (new philodendron, tiny triumph)
All: :tada: :seedling:
Marie L.: thanks team — office horticulture and network stability are both restored. will avoid metal-clamp mounts near routers in the future.
